AboutPage.title: Design useful products, ship them cleanly
AboutPage.subtitle: A human-sized product and development studio with direct communication.
AboutPage.storyBody:
Yodev starts from a simple principle: fewer intermediaries make it easier to understand the problem and decide quickly.

Each engagement begins with concrete framing and progresses through verifiable deliverables. Constraints, trade-offs and limits remain visible throughout the project.

The goal is not to sell an abstract transformation, but to ship a useful, maintainable and transferable product.

values.title: Build and verify
values.description: Each increment is tied to a need, acceptance criteria and evidence that it works.

values.title: Useful transparency
values.description: Budget, timeline, risks and trade-offs are visible while decisions can still be made.

values.title: Transferable product
values.description: Code, documentation and access are organized to avoid artificial dependency on the provider.
